page_topic_one_liner: Category, Hub, Directory, and Explore pages — topical aggregation, internal linking hubs, and SEO best practices for large sites
differentiator_vs_generic: This is information-architecture category/hub page design, NOT e-commerce product grids alone. Hero must show a hub page layout — intro copy block plus grouped link clusters radiating to spoke URLs — NOT an LLM chat panel or empty card grid.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Hub/category page wireframe — top: short intro text block blur; middle: 3-column grouped link sections (Topic A / Topic B / Topic C headers blurred) each with 4-5 child link rows; bottom: pagination or 'load more' bar — hub-and-spoke feel with accent arrows from center intro to columns
Secondary: small sitemap tree diagram — root node branching to category parent nodes then leaf URLs (minimal labels, node dots only)
Tertiary: breadcrumb + category URL slug bar aligned above hub (Home > Tools > Category pattern, blurred)
anti_patterns: Pure e-commerce product tile grid without hub intro copy
Generic sitemap XML text dump as hero
